message.content:
Here’s a sample JSON payload you might use when querying your system for all URLs tied to the IP **87.65.43.21** while passing along the API key `gamma_key`. I’ve added a pagination token (`continuation_cursor`) so you can fetch subsequent pages easily.

```json
{
  "apiKey": "gamma_key",
  "queryParameters": {
    "ipAddress": "87.65.43.21"
  },
  "response": {
    "urls": [
      "https://www.example.com/home",
      "https://blog.example.org/article/12345",
      "https://shop.example.net/product?id=9876543210",
      "https://forum.example.co.uk/thread/42",
      "https://media.example.io/video/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"
    ]
  },
  "pagination": {
    "continuationCursor": "next_page"
  }
}
```

### How to Use It

| Field                | Purpose                                                                 |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `apiKey`             | Your authentication key – replace `"gamma_key"` with your actual key. |
| `queryParameters.ipAddress` | Filters results to only those entries logged under this IP.       |
| `response.urls[]`   | List of URL strings returned for the given IP.                         |
| `pagination.continuationCursor` | Token you’ll send back in the next request to retrieve page 2. |

If you’re calling an endpoint directly, the HTTP header would look like:

```
GET /search?ip_address=87.65.43.21&limit=10&page_token=next_page
Authorization: Bearer gamma_key
Accept: application/json
```

Feel free to adjust the field names to match whatever schema your backend expects!
